title: CEP-0002 Media & Multi-Modal Asset Provenance
description: Standardized metadata schema for media cut manifests, color LUTs, audio stems, and inspection stills.

type.description: Primary role of the media asset.

fps.description: Temporal playback frequency in frames per second.

duration_seconds.description: Total asset runtime duration in seconds.

codec.description: Video/audio encoding specification, e.g. h264_nvenc, hevc, aac.

color_profile.description: Color space and transfer curve, e.g. bt709, rec2020, srgb.

review_path.description: Relative URI for local-first HTTP 206 byte-range media review streaming.

inspection_frames.description: Ordered stills captured at key timestamps for visual regression verification.

name.description: Descriptive title of the inspection marker.

timestamp_seconds.description: Offset in seconds where the frame was captured.
